verdict_reason: Dropping the contact row and section from each case is correct, but the positional status arrays hide which row each entry is for.

todos.issue: The expected row and section statuses are unlabelled positional arrays (rows at lines 35-47, 60-72, 88-100, 121-133, 146-158, 164-176; sections at 48-55, 73-80, 101-108, 134-141, 159, 177). Removing the contact row meant deleting one anonymous NOT_STARTED/FULFILLED per case, and neither the author nor a reviewer can see which row or section an entry stands for, so a deletion at the wrong index with an equal value passes silently.
todos.fix: Must: each expected status is tied to the task row id or answer section id it describes, so adding or removing a row changes a named entry. One way: write rows and sections as objects keyed by id ({ origin: NOT_STARTED, ... }) and compare against Object.fromEntries(taskRows.map((row) => [row.id, statusOf(...)])), likewise for answerSections.
